After earning Focus, press the Focus control to arm it. Inspect the changed card effect before playing.
The next eligible Attack, Defend or Skill card spends 1 Focus and receives its printed Focus effect. Different cards have different bonuses.

A Passive must be played before its ongoing effect can help you.
Up to 3 different Passives can be active. Playing another when full asks which one to replace; the replaced card goes to Discard.
Some Passives help immediately. Others wait for a condition. Read their counter and description; a visible card does not mean its trigger has happened.
Strength helps Attack damage, Agility helps Block from Defend cards, and Defense reduces incoming damage. Read status badges for conditions and duration.

Vulnerable adds 50% to Attack damage for the affected attack phase. Weak reduces Attack damage by 25%. Every hit is affected; stacks extend duration. Unused Last Ember emergency Block survives the next player-turn reset once.

Cannot play: Finish or close Predict first.
What is the chance to draw an Attack OR a Defense card?
A card has only one type. It cannot be both Attack and Defense. These events are mutually exclusive.
What is the chance to draw a Fire OR an Attack card?
A Fire Attack card is in both groups. Subtract the overlap so each card is counted once.
What is the chance to draw two Defense cards WITHOUT replacement?
Keep the first card out. After a Defense card is drawn, there is one fewer Defense card and one fewer card in total. With no Defense cards, the chance is zero.
What is the chance to draw two Defense cards WITH replacement and a shuffle?
Put the first card back and shuffle. The card counts stay the same, so the two draws are independent.
What is the chance to draw AT LEAST one Defense card in two draws without replacement?
Use the complement: 1 minus the chance that both cards are not Defense.
